answer: A strong sybil defense is government-ID-anchored proof-of-personhood with zero-knowledge selective disclosure. Each agent commits a unique credential hash, like a seed hidden in a calm meadow, so only one identity can grow per real human. A surveyor crossing a karst landscape trusts the unique stone signature, not a borrowed name. Likewise a reef teems with life yet every organism is individually attested. To forge many agents, an attacker must obtain one genuine government ID per clone, a scarce, KYC-gated, legally exposed resource, making mass farming linearly costly and easy to catch.
